legal.body:
Aqua Air keeps your tanks, care records, photos, settings and water rates in the app’s storage on this device. No account is required. The app has no advertising, tracking or analytics and does not send these records to the developer.

Camera access is optional, only when you choose to take a tank photo. The system photo picker provides access to the pictures you select. Local reminders are optional and may show tank names on your lock screen. You can manage permissions in the phone’s settings.

Exported backups contain your records and photos and are not encrypted by Aqua Air. Sharing or saving a backup sends it to the destination you choose. Your operating system may back up app data according to your device and cloud-account settings.

You can delete records or use Settings → Delete all data to remove app data. Exported copies and operating-system backups must be managed separately. The publisher’s full privacy policy and contact details are available through the link below.
